description: One row per device per 5-minute reading. Zone and meter rows share the table; each leaves the other device type's fields null.
types_note: Types are Glue/Hive names. Every reading is double, so JSON 640 and 640.0 both load into it, while an int column would reject 21.4.

columns.name: ts
columns.comment: Reading time in UTC, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-10T03:05:00Z. Kept as text in raw; cast to timestamp in curated.

columns.name: building_id
columns.comment: Added by the IoT rule from campus/{building}/{device}, e.g. bldg-a

columns.name: device_id
columns.comment: Added by the IoT rule from campus/{building}/{device}, e.g. zone-07 or meter-main

columns.name: setpoint_c
columns.comment: Temperature the controller is aiming for, degrees C

columns.name: heating_valve_pct
columns.comment: Heating valve position as reported by the controller, 0-100

columns.name: cooling_valve_pct
columns.comment: Cooling valve position as reported by the controller, 0-100

columns.name: kw
columns.comment: Average electrical demand over the 5 minutes ending at ts, kW

columns.name: kwh_total
columns.comment: Cumulative meter reading at ts, kWh; never decreases
